title: Pathways to Success skyline mural
story: A community center in the Loop wanted their front lobby to greet students with the Chicago skyline they see every day. We printed the Pathways to Success artwork, Millennium Park's Bean, students mid-stride, at full 60 by 50 inch scale directly onto primed drywall. The matte finish keeps glare down under the lobby's overhead lighting so the mural reads cleanly from the entrance.

photos.alt: Installed custom wall print in a Chicago interior, viewed from across the room
